title: Page header
summary: The single header every screen uses: title, optional description, navigation above and actions at the end. It replaces the per-module headers in both apps.

demos.title: Title and description
demos.note: The title is the page's h1, so use one page header per screen. The description is optional.

c.name: Everything you are currently prescribed.
c.text: Everything you are currently prescribed. Ask your care team before stopping or changing a dose.

demos.title: With actions
demos.note: Actions align with the baseline of the title and wrap below it when space runs out. One primary button at most.
